protocol.selection: Highest validation macro-F1; earliest epoch on ties. Fusion ties prefer 0.5, then smaller video weight.
protocol.refit: Reset each encoder to the same seed; train on odd subjects for its selected epoch count.

preprocess.video: uniform decoded frames; aspect-preserving resize and center crop; RGB
preprocess.imu: linear interpolation over relative trial duration; six original channels
preprocess.alignment: paired whole trials; no exact timestamp alignment assumed

limitations: Single-seed evaluation on a small segmented benchmark; no live-stream or new-environment claim.
Softmax and fused scores are not calibrated confidence estimates.
Whole-trial relative resampling does not establish exact cross-modal time alignment.
Sensor placement differs between action groups; no pretrained weights are used.
